macos.releaseNotes:
float 0.6.5

软件更新
• 加入应用内下载、安装与重启更新。
• 自动检查更新可在“设置 → 更新”关闭；安装由你确认。
• 更新包与更新说明经过签名校验，模型、词库和个人设置保留。
• 修复更新入口需要用户填写地址的问题。

Software updates
• Download, install and restart to update from inside the app.
• Automatic update checks can be turned off in Settings → Updates. Installation remains your choice.
• Signed update packages and feeds. Existing models, dictionaries and preferences are preserved.
• The update source is configured for you.
